title: Offset concept proliferation without suppressing design-space exploration
objective: Add controls that prevent uncontrolled canonical expansion while preserving broad speculative exploration.

weaknesses.description: Concept generation can outpace validation and integration capacity.

mitigations.control: Keep speculative concepts in sandbox branches and require evidence-based promotion gates before canonical integration.
mitigations.activation_trigger: Any concept proposed for canonical promotion.
new_risks: useful concepts may remain shelved too long

manual: Review that experimental and canonical states remain separate.
machine: Check every canonical concept has a promotion record.

mitigations.review_condition: Review when promotion latency blocks a validated milestone.
mitigations.removal_condition: Retire only if another control preserves exploration with lower integration risk.

stages.name: mitigation_and_offset_design
stages.manual_notes: The human identified the value-bearing mechanism and rejected suppression of ideation.
stages.machine_notes: The tool verified that the mitigation names preserved benefits, trade-offs, new risks and review conditions.
stages.decision: Use staging and promotion gates rather than reducing candidate generation.

manual_checks: Confirm the mitigation does not cap idea generation.
